Scene-Re will perform speed change at different times according to your choice, the differences are as follows 

Lower speed: only reset the charging speed when the charger is connected and the charge percentage changes 
Accelerate charging: reset the charging speed when the battery status changes and the charger is connected 
Charge to death: automatically reset the charging speed every second based on the logic of [Charge to accelerate] Speed

If this option is not turned on, Scene-Re will only execute the scheduling profile when it needs to change gears, for example: switching between multiple applications set to [power saving mode], the scheduling profile only Will be executed once. 

In strict mode, Scene-Re will execute the scheduling configuration file every time the foreground application changes, and notify the application (package name) that is switched to the foreground to run. Scheduling configuration authors can use this feature to individually design scheduling parameters for different applications, and are no longer limited to the limitation of only four gears. 

When the Snapdragon 855, 865, and 888 models use the [Classic Configuration] [Performance Focus] configuration source, you can turn on the strict mode and experience the exclusive optimization in the following applications:
